context: Request: the firm's most recent filed willful-infringement case and its supporting document, to lead with for a client. Rubric: 1021-00004 (Verimark Hospitality trademark complaint filed July 22, 2025, Pleadings/complaint-trademark-infringement.docx) as the only answer; 1013-00005 (GenomeDx patent complaint, March 2025), 1014-00004 and others are earlier, and 1017-00003 (Aurelius, March 2026) is an unfiled draft.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review asks for an untruncated matter list.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists every matter folder with its file count.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Attempt 2: prints the total (266), the number range and the file-count range.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; five range-split scans with a loose pattern write 3,109 lines (260 shown, about 48K characters), and a grep of the output is capped at 120 lines. The review rates the goal not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: exact-phrase scan in five ranges confirmed to cover all 266 matters; 17 hit matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: proximity scan; 35 hit matters. The review flags a hand-picked shortlist of nine.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: A heredoc error, then full file listings of the 35 hit matters saved (1,594 lines, 320 shown).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two parallel batches: ten complaints, answers and a draft complaint, then eight status letters, emails and memos; the summary dates the lead matter's filing from its status letter and sets aside a later draft. The review flags unopened sibling matters.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Compares the matter sets of the two saved scans (union 35); the agent reports the goal not reached. The end-of-stage label note names Calculate figures for the answer; no later work of that kind followed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Extract complaint dates per candidate (suggested by the review). Store-wide script over pleading- and status-named files printing dates and snippets (73 lines); the review flags the name filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Extract complaint dates per candidate (attempt 2). Name-independent proximity scan over all 266 matters with the first date per file (304 files, 35 matters).

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: new: Verify complaints per matter (suggested by the review). Script over the pleading- and status-named files of the 35 hit matters printing filing dates and openings.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the lead matter's complaint as the most recent filed case, with its status letter, dated comparisons and the exclusion of a later unfiled draft.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, the two cited documents and the openings of the draft and its status report; checks two paths. No edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: a matter-folder listing (T0, T1), store-wide extraction scans narrowed from a loose pattern (outputs of about 363K characters in T2 and 1.23M in T1) to exact request phrases, one or two parallel screening batches of complaints and status documents across the hit matters, a dated filing confirmation for the lead matter from its status letter or motion memo, and an answer that cites the lead matter's complaint, lists older filed cases and excludes a later unfiled draft. T0 added agent-declared store-wide date scans and a per-matter complaint check before writing; T1 checked the runner-up's filing date in an agent-declared recency stage and, after writing, screened the five surfaced matters a check review named, adding one sentence to the answer; T2 ran one more filename-prefiltered date scan. All agent-declared stages map onto existing scan, within-matter search, in-depth reading and check stages.
